get.description: Returns aggregate available, reserved and issued slot counts for the capped first-1,000 promotional Agent Passport Certificate campaign. Counts represent cryptographic Passport grants, not unique humans, companies, customers or paid sales.

200.description: Founding 1000 campaign policy and aggregate availability

post.summary: Claim one free Founding 1000 Agent Passport Certificate
post.description: Requires an active cryptographic Agent Passport signature over accordtrace.passport-product.founding-1000.claim.v1. One promotional grant is allowed per Passport. The grant requires no card or payment, does not qualify as a paid sale, and creates no direct-referral commission.

201.description: Founding Certificate issued from a reserved campaign slot

200.description: Idempotent replay returned the previously issued Founding Certificate

409.description: Campaign full, duplicate product issuance, replay mismatch, or conflicting order

503.description: Campaign disabled or Certificate signing is not ready

post.summary: Create a signed US$2 Agent Passport Certificate Checkout session
post.description: Requires an active cryptographic Agent Passport signature over accordtrace.passport-product.checkout.v1. The affiliate program is separate and optional. If referral_code is supplied, the referred Passport must already have cryptographically reserved that direct attribution. This paid path is separate from the capped Founding 1000 promotional grant path.

409.description: Replay, open-order, existing-certificate, or referral-attribution conflict

503.description: Commercial launch gates are not complete

post.summary: Receive verified Stripe events for the Agent Passport Certificate product
post.description: Stripe HMAC signature verification is performed on the untouched raw body before parsing. Only verified paid events with the exact configured product amount/currency can fulfill a paid Certificate and qualify a direct referral commission. Founding 1000 grants never enter this settlement path.

post.summary: Verify an Agent Passport Certificate issuer signature
post.description: Checks the Certificate schema, AccordTrace issuer key and Ed25519 signature. A valid Certificate proves historical AccordTrace issuance only, not legal identity, KYC, Trust, safety or validation.
